claim: No Napoleon pack header lists a dependency (pack-name list empty in all 11); header types are boot.pack 0, eight release packs 1 (battleterrain, buildings, data, local_en, rigidmodels, sound, variantmodels, variantmodels2), local_en_patch.pack 2 and media.pack 4; assumed, not verified: the load order the tools use is type then name (the game's own order is not read from the exe)
notes: verified covers the pack headers only (no dependency list, the header types); the type-then-name order is the tools' assumption, the game's own order is not read from the exe (J7 review Later 3). The order between release packs never matters in vanilla: the only shadowing is local_en to local_en_patch
